lines.ko: 밤에 걸어둔 첫 자동 실행이 안 됐습니다.
lines.en: The first automated run I scheduled at night never happened.
There wasn't even an error message.
The cause was a condition I had written in the settings file.

lines.ko: 지원되지 않는 자리에 써서 파일이 통째로 무시됐습니다.
lines.en: I put it in a spot that doesn't support it, so the whole file was ignored.

lines.ko: 그 조건을 걷어내고 확인 방식을 바꿨습니다.
lines.en: I removed the condition and checked it a different way.
Only then did posts start going up automatically every night.
The 3 screens I built during the day fill up like this.

lines.ko: 지금 보시는 이 영상도 그 글에서 나왔습니다.
lines.en: Even this video came out of one of those posts.

lines.ko: 밤새 글과 영상이 끝까지 만들어지는지 지켜봅니다.
lines.en: Next I watch whether the post and the video really finish overnight.
lines.art: a small owl perched on a stack of gears, watching a dark conveyor belt carry glowing parcels

lines.en: I don't write the posts myself.

failCard.afterEn: Removing the wrong condition got it running every night
